description: This file defines classes and functions related to logging and informational output within the ANGLE project's shader translator component. It includes the definition of TInfoSinkBase and TInfoSink classes, methods for appending various data types to logs, and a utility function for extracting the fractional part of a float.

classes.name: TInfoSinkBase
classes.description: A class providing methods to log messages, including appending various data types and managing log content.

classes.name: TInfoSink
classes.description: A container class holding different TInfoSinkBase instances for info, debug, and object logs.

methods.name: fractionalPart
methods.description: Returns the fractional part of a floating-point number.
